text.en:
Proximity Explosive Knife applies 60 Scorch on detonation. 
Direct Hit Kills with Proximity Explosive Knife ignite.

500% Additional Base Melee Recharge Rate while Proximity Knife remains unexploded.
text.ko:
근접 칼이 폭발할 시 알 수 없는 양의 소각 스택을 입힙니다. 적중시켜 처치하면 해당 타겟을 점화시킵니다.

근접 칼이 폭발하지 않고 있는 동안 알 수 없는 만큼의 근접 공격 재생 속도를 증가시킵니다.
text.zh-chs:
感应飞刀在爆炸时施加 60 层灼烧。
如果使用感应飞刀直接击中击杀敌人，则会触发点燃效果。

感应飞刀未爆炸时，近战技能基础冷却速度增加 500%。

<solar/>Proximity Explosive Knife applies 60 <solar/>Scorch on detonation. (Unaffected by <solar/>Ember of Ashes)

Proximity Explosive Knife kills trigger an <solar/>Ignition.

<solar/>Ignition kills (on any subclass) grant a full Melee Ability Charge. This can overflow into one additional <solar/>Solar Knife charge (any knife) or one additional <stasis/>Withering Blade charge beyond capacity.

On Prismatic, this can overflow into two additional <solar/>Knife Trick or <stasis/>Withering Blade charges, for four total Melee Charges.
